name: mcp-get
stderr:
Usage: mcp-get [options] [command]

Package manager for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers

Options:
  -V, --version                      output the version number
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  browse [options]                   Browse all available MCP servers
  config [options]                   Show or modify configuration
  help [command]                     display help for command
  info|show [options] <name>         Show detailed information about an MCP
                                     server
  install [options] <name>           Install an MCP server from the registry
  list|ls [options]                  List installed MCP servers
  login                              Log in to MCPSkills registry
  logout                             Log out from MCPSkills registry
  remove|uninstall [options] <name>  Remove an installed MCP server
  search [options] [query]           Search for MCP servers in the registry
  status                             Show Claude Desktop configuration status
  update|upgrade [options] [name]    Update installed MCP server(s) to latest
                                     version
  whoami                             Show current logged-in user
